reading_note: The arc traces how divine providence, before any malformation of falsity-from-evil can fully erupt into manifest existence, has already prepared its place of confinement. Six successive "beforehand" cycles are recounted: (1) before the places of deceit are produced, three confining cavities are shaped to bind them; (2) before the boundary between the natural and corrupted realms is set, the Father of Life establishes a wall around the great sea of the natural mind in which truths sail; (3) before the cosmic order is manifested, what fell into the sea of natural-degree thought (Enthumesis) is given a fixed station between the four winds, and matter is drawn into the midst of worlds where the Wrestler grasps it and stands fast upon it to the consummation; (4) before Error and the dregs of Darkness are driven from creation, a containment is made for them; (5) before hostile powers clothed in the archonic host can tyrannize through dark beasts, clouds, winds, spirits and birds, they are fixed in the great sea outside the seven places and cast into the abyss; (6) before the abortions reach the earth, before Watchers transgress and the giants are begotten with their twelve cities and millennia of life — even these have their prison prepared in the depth of the lower land. The single teaching: every disorder of self-love is preceded in the divine order by the confinement that will hold it. Falsity is never released without its limiting form already established.
